credits.title: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova
credits.overview: Godzilla and Kong return in an all-new adventure as Earth's greatest titans face an unthinkable threat from beyond the stars. When an Apex cosmic predator sets its sights on Earth, only the combined might of monsters and humanity can avert total extinction.

credits.title: THE BOOK OF JOB
credits.overview: Job is introduced as an incredibly wealthy man. God and Satan engage in a Supernatural discussion resulting in Satan gaining permission to 'test' Job by destroying his possessions and family.

credits.title: In A Place Like This
credits.overview: A day in the life of Horace, an outback isolationist who holds within him a dark and violent secret. This non-conventional approach to the slasher sub-genre offers a new perspective. credits.title: Get Free
credits.overview: Seven girls are taken, who will get free?

credits.title: Lonesome
credits.overview: Casey, a country lad running from a small-town scandal, finds himself down and out in big city Sydney. When he meets city lad Tib both men find something they have been missing but neither of them knows quite how to negotiate it.
